question: Should autonomous jobs be allowed to close issue-only duplicate clusters without first producing a fix PR when the cluster passes the existing canonical and security safeguards?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it deliberately changes the repository’s cleanup policy from repair-first to terminal duplicate closure for one class of clusters; source tests cannot determine the acceptable false-positive risk.

options.title: Approve issue-only duplicate closure
options.body: Merge the change and treat the existing canonical, hydration, and security gates as sufficient for terminal issue-only duplicate cleanup.

options.title: Keep fix-first quarantine
options.body: Retain the current guard so autonomous close remains blocked until a repair or other fix path exists, even for issue-only clusters.

options.title: Define a narrower close predicate
options.body: Require an additional explicit duplicate-confidence or canonical-evidence condition before allowing issue-only terminal closure.

recommendation.title: Approve issue-only duplicate closure
recommendation.body: Merge the change and treat the existing canonical, hydration, and security gates as sufficient for terminal issue-only duplicate cleanup.
